## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 2361 invitations and 879 attendances. This represents an attendance rate of 37.2%. The figures provide a straightforward summary of participation among those invited and indicate the number who attended following the invitation process.

Attendance is reported here as the relationship between the total invited and the total attended. The figures are presented for review and can support routine assessment of outreach reach and participation.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 2031 invitations. A reminder message was also received by 2031 people. These figures show the recorded use of text messaging both at the invitation stage and for subsequent reminders.

The contact figures are included alongside the invitation and attendance totals to provide a concise account of outreach communications and participation.

Prepared by G. Evans.
